top_signals.title: Tidal Energy Could Cover 57% of US Electricity Demand, NREL Study Finds
top_signals.summary: An Alaska-based tidal energy company is testing a new kind of small, modular turbine in the waters off of Massachusetts to try to take advantage of the United States’ vast and untapped tidal power potential. The turbine is being piloted in the strong tidal currents of Cape Cod to test the technology’s performance and durability in real-world conditions in order to explore whether it could be suitable for commercial scaling. Tapping into the country’s tidal energy potential could be a major game changer for decarbonization and…
